checks.description: Real SQLite query_only rejects production routing ingress; no receipt, message/root/Wake/outbox/Attempt or phantom completion survives factory rebuild.
Independent real SQLite writer causes SQLITE_BUSY with no false success; after lock release an exact idempotent ingress retry creates one root/message.

Six actual SQLite ABORT triggers at output/response/successor/terminal/Run/budget-outcome prove terminal publication rollback; verified supplier usage stays known, recovery remains unknown and never blindly replays.
Post-commit coordinator release failure preserves response/successor/terminal/Run/known cost atomically; rebuild repairs only the exact release and the original-root successor runs once.
Actual request-evidence INSERT abort rolls back the send barrier and sends zero requests; it cannot publish a response or charge nonexistent output/cost.
Model bytes received with failed receipt persistence never imply success/zero cost/no-send; durable unknown usage keeps its reserve and recovery issues no replacement request.
Real readonly approval decision preserves pending/awaiting_approval; repaired exact Owner decision is idempotent and resumes the same live driver without another provider request.
Pending approval under permission/member/account revocation cannot approve or publish the old response; rebuilt production authority grants no blind replay or old-driver resurrection.
Actual SQLITE_FULL from a disposable max_page_count capacity cap rejects production ingress atomically; restoring capacity/reopening finds no phantom receipt and permits one fresh root.

Actual SQLite readonly fault after send prevents receipt and unknown-outcome writes; execution rejects instead of reporting saved/completed, and repaired storage recovers unknown with its reserve/fence and zero blind resend.

composition: createThreadedProduction + durable release grants + production authority + real better-sqlite3

storageFaults.readonly: Actual PRAGMA query_only rejects SQLite writes at ingress, approval decision and after-send receipt/outcome persistence
storageFaults.contention: Independent real SQLite BEGIN IMMEDIATE writer causes SQLITE_BUSY
storageFaults.capacity: Actual SQLITE_FULL caused by max_page_count at the disposable database current page count; the host disk is not filled
storageFaults.transactionAbort: Real SQLite triggers execute RAISE(ABORT) at six terminal publication boundaries and backend request/receipt boundaries
storageFaults.resourceRelease: Injected coordinator release exception after durable terminal commit

limitations: This is a rebuilt production factory with actual SQLite connection closes/reopens; it does not run apps/server/src/index.ts or terminate a PID.
SQLite readonly/contention are real database errors. Trigger ABORT validates transaction rollback, not arbitrary disk-full, fsync, file-permission or physical media failure.
Supplier transport and responses are deterministic injections; no real API/SDK/network or substantive model behavior is claimed.
Only the disposable root receives a normal Owner budget CAS to a ten-second renewable activity slice; default one-second long-preparation behavior is not accepted by this suite.
